title: 28:16 I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone. This is a prophecy of Jesus Christ, in which he is called a stone, a tried stone (or a stone tested for strength), and a precious corner stone. A cornerstone adds permanence and strength to the foundation of a building. Here the building is the latter-day Zion, and "he that believeth" may have a "sure foundation" on which to build (1 Pet. 2:6-8).
author: Tina M. Peterson
